items.title: [ECG] SUTD Engineering Systems and Design (ESD) Experience
items.author: Klyne Mary Ann
items.description:
Dear HCI students, we are pleased to invite you to apply for the
Engineering
Systems and Design (ESD) Experience 2026
, taking place from
30 November
to 11 December 2026
at SUTD.
This programme is suitable for students who are interested in
optimising
complex systems using Mathematics, Statistics and Coding
.
Designed to provide participants with an immersive, hands-on experience,
the programme will introduce students to how
engineering can be applied to
solve complex real-world challenges
. It aims to inspire a new generation of
innovators, analysts, engineers and researchers who can harness
design,
artificial intelligence (AI) and technology
to analyse and optimise
large-scale complex systems for a better world.
Through interactive workshops, classroom learning, research immersion,
industry-inspired simulations and student engagements, participants will:
Explore how
to tackle complex challenges in
aviation, transportation, supply chains
and operations management
.
Experience actual
ESD classes, including
Supply Chain Digitalisation and Design, Airport
Systems Modelling and Simulation, and Urban Transportation
.
Participate
in hands-on simulations, games and team-based problem-solving activities
that mirror real-world industry decision-making.
Gain
exposure to cutting-edge research through an immersion at the
Aviation
Studies Institute (ASI)
.
Develop
analytical,
presentation and communication skills
through project work and
showcases.
Learn about
the
ESD curriculum, specialisations, overseas exchanges, minors and
Capstone project opportunities
.
Please refer to the attached document for more details.
Interested students may
apply here
by 7 Oct 2026.

items.title: [NAFA] 🎼 Bachelor of Education (Honours) in Instrumental and Vocal Teaching programme 🎤
items.author: Hung Ching Wen, Annie
items.description:
Dear College Staff and Students,
NAFA would like to share with us about their
Bachelor of Education (Honours) in Instrumental & Vocal Teaching programme.
This is for students, fellow music educators, and aspiring teachers who may be interested in deepening their expertise and building a meaningful career in music education.
Through this programme, they aim to equip aspiring and practising instrumental and vocal teachers with the pedagogical knowledge, artistic excellence, and professional competencies needed to thrive in today's music education landscape.
🎥 Programme Information Session Recording
YouTube Link:
https://youtu.be/YXm7UYFLFPY
As Singapore continues to strengthen its arts and cultural landscape, there is a growing need for dedicated educator-performers who can nurture, inspire, and guide future generations of musicians.
NAFA welcome the opportunity to work alongside music schools, educators, and industry partners to develop talent and raise the standards of music teaching across the sector.
To learn more about the programme, please visit:
🔗
https://www.nafa.edu.sg/programmes/bachelor-of-education-(honours)-in-instrumental-vocal-teaching
We hope this information provides valuable insights into how the programme can support both aspiring and experienced music educators in advancing their professional practice and contributing meaningfully to Singapore's music education ecosystem.
